title: Microbiology, B.S. (Eberly College of Science)
notes: Fetched directly from the archived 2025-26 bulletin. Structurally very close to MICRB-2026.json -- same 'options' structure (General Microbiology / Medical Microbiology), same common-requirement elective math confirmed against this year's own bulletin text ('MICRB Elective List A (Applied): 3cr min' + 'MICRB Elective List B: 3cr' + 'MICRB Elective List C (free): 11cr' common, plus the General Microbiology option's own 'Select 6 credits from MICRB Elective List B' -- List A 3cr / List B 9cr / List C 11cr, identical total to 2026), same MICRB 401/450 sequence positions as 2026 (MICRB 450 in Year 3 Fall, MICRB 401 in Year 4 Fall -- unlike 2024's transitional swap, see MICRB-2024.json's notes), same List-B pairing with MICRB 415 in Year 3 Spring as 2026, and the PPEM 456/MICRB 456 cross-listing already confirmed (this year's own sample plan literally prints 'MICRB 456' in the Year 4 Fall row while its Program Requirements table lists the same course as 'PPEM 456: Applied Microbial Ecology'). One real, specifically-confirmed difference from 2026: this year's Suggested Academic Plan still keeps ENGL 15/30H (Year 1 Fall) and CAS 100A/B/C (Year 1 Spring) as two separate Gen Ed Foundations items, the same as 2022-2024, rather than 2026's single merged 'ENGL 15 (or CAS 100A/B/C)' item in Semester 2 -- 2026 evidently merged these into one flexible slot and used the freed Semester 1 credit for an extra MICRB Elective List C slot instead. Consequently this year's List C total (11cr, same as 2026) is reached via 3 slots (3+4+4) rather than 2026's 4 slots (3+3+3+2), matching this year's own printed 'List C Elective (3)' / 'ListC Electives (3-4)' / 'ListC Electives (3-4)' plan lines. Same MATH 3->4->21->22 real-prereq-chain scaffold as every other catalog year (Backend/catalogs/*.json prereq data isn't versioned per catalog year). 'etm' marks the same Entrance-to-Major gateway courses as every other year (CHEM 110, MATH 140, MICRB 201).
